deadline.value: The 2027/28 main round closes at 11:59 p.m. Hong Kong time. Later applications may be considered if places remain. HKPFS registration with the RGC is due by noon on the same date.

also.quote: Applications received after the above-mentioned deadline may be considered subject to the availability of student places.
Applicants must first register on the RGC’s Online Application System (OAS) and obtain a reference number before 1 December 2026 (12:00 noon Hong Kong time).
* at 11:59 p.m. (Hong Kong Time or GMT +8 hours)

gre_subject.value: No distinct GRE Subject Test policy was identified on the programme or central pages checked.

supervisor.value: The department instructs applicants to contact a faculty member before filing. Applications supported by the proposed supervisor are forwarded for a decision.
supervisor.quote: Qualified applications supported by the proposed supervisor will then be forwarded

also.quote: you should contact a faculty member of the Department in your proposed area of work who may eventually become your supervisor before you submit a full online application

funding.value: Government-funded places with studentship are limited. Candidates can apply as self-financed students as well.
funding.quote: Government-funded PhD places with studentship are limited and therefore highly competitive. Suitably qualified candidates can also apply for admission as self-financed research students without studentship.

entry_route.value: A first-class honours bachelor's degree or equivalent, a recognised master's degree, or a higher research degree can qualify. CityUHK MPhil transfer is a separate route.
entry_route.quote: PhD (students with a bachelor's or a master's degree)

also.quote: hold a Bachelor’s degree with first class honours (or equivalent qualification) from a recognised university.
hold a Master’s degree (or equivalent qualification) from a recognised university;

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 4.5 for tests from 21 January 2026. The previous scale minimum was 79. Scores must be valid at submission and are valid for two years.
toefl_min.quote: a score of 79 (for tests taken prior to 21 January 2026) or 4.5 (for tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards) (Internet-based test) in the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL)

also.quote: TOEFL and IELTS scores are considered valid for two years from the test date and must be valid at the time of submission of application.

notes: Official research-degree catalogue: https://www.cityu.edu.hk/catalogue/pg/202627/programme/MNE_P.htm. The department page uses the legacy 79 iBT floor. The current graduate school's 79 legacy and 4.5 new-scale rule specifies the test date cutoff.
